notes: Universe = base cells only (no modifiers). Modifier and .hash cells are auxiliary measured evidence, not universe members; see module docstring. Dispositions live in fleet/dispositions.json (cell -> {disposition, evidence, from, rule}); allowed dispositions: MEASURED, INFERRED, PARITY-ONLY, EXCLUDED-INVALID, NOT-CLAIMED.

blocks.name: probe_grid
blocks.rationale: Primary claim surface: probe-side AMAC lookup on the DRAM-resident S3 map across every key family and the full thread axis.

blocks.name: size_ladder
blocks.rationale: Map-residency ladder (L2 -> L3 -> DRAM): AMAC's win must grow with map size; S1 bounds the small-map regression risk.

blocks.name: thread_ladder
blocks.rationale: Thread scaling off the S3 anchor: key64 becomes a full 5-size x 3-thread grid; mixed (composite numeric+string key) gets its thread axis here.

blocks.name: kind_strictness
blocks.rationale: The routed probe must not regress non-INNER kinds/strictnesses (LEFT/FULL/ANY/SEMI/ASOF instantiations) at the size where AMAC engages.

blocks.name: build
blocks.rationale: Build-insert ring claim: build-heavy cells (small probe) across key kinds and sizes; S1/S5 bound the ladder, T48 checks mid-parallelism.

blocks.name: dup_heavy
blocks.rationale: Duplicate chains (16x) stress collision-chain walking in the AMAC ring and RowRef list handling on both build and probe.

blocks.name: hit_rate
blocks.rationale: h=0.5/0.05: misses terminate lookups early and shift the ring's prefetch-to-work ratio; must not regress miss-heavy probes.

blocks.name: join_use_nulls
blocks.rationale: join_use_nulls=1 changes output column wrapping, not the lookup; one sentinel cell proves in-band.

blocks.name: stats_on
blocks.rationale: collect_hash_table_stats_during_joins=1 alters initial map sizing (fewer growths); both sides sampled once.

hash_inband.rationale: G-hash-inband gate: the tail-padded grower rebind also changes join_algorithm='hash'; these 12 A/B cells (hash on BOTH arms) must all verdict in-band (TIE).
